name: es31-image-load-store
title: Image load/store
summary: Shader image load/store: glBindImageTexture of immutable textures (all 13 image formats of Table 8.26, layered and non-layered bindings, cube face mapping, level selection, format reinterpretation by size) read and written by imageLoad/imageStore/imageSize in compute and fragment shaders; a 3x3 blur and a Sobel filter against CPU references; readonly/writeonly/coherent/volatile/restrict and their compile-time rules; IMAGE_BINDING_* state through glGetIntegeri_v/glGetBooleani_v, IMAGE_FORMAT_COMPATIBILITY_TYPE, the errors of glBindImageTexture; memory barriers between image writes and sampler/framebuffer/buffer reads.
spec: ES 3.2 §8.23 Texture Image Loads and Stores: BindImageTexture and its errors, Table 8.24 (layer number -> cube map face), Table 8.25 (image coordinates), Table 8.26 (supported image unit formats), Table 8.27 (texel sizes, compatibility by size, format reinterpretation), invalid-access and format-mismatch rules; §8.23.1 Image Unit Queries, Table 21.33 Image State (initial values)
ES 3.2 §8.11.2 Texture Parameter Queries (IMAGE_FORMAT_COMPATIBILITY_TYPE); §20.1 Simple Queries (GetIntegeri_v / GetBooleani_v, INVALID_VALUE for an index out of range)
ES 3.2 §7.11 Shader Memory Access: §7.11.1 ordering, §7.11.2 MemoryBarrier (SHADER_IMAGE_ACCESS, TEXTURE_FETCH, FRAMEBUFFER and BUFFER_UPDATE bits; coherent variables)

ES 3.2 §2.3.5.2 Conversion from Floating-Point to Normalized Fixed-Point (imageStore into rgba8 / rgba8_snorm: one of the two closest integers), §2.3.5.1 (texel fetch of normalized formats), §2.3.1 Errors (an erroring command has no effect), §17 Compute Shaders (DispatchCompute)
ES 3.2 §8.5 / Table 8.3 (upload format/type pairs), §9.2 (framebuffer objects used for glReadPixels of image-written textures), §6 (MapBufferRange of a buffer written by shaders)

GLSL ES 3.10 §4.1.7.2 Images, §4.4.7 Format Layout Qualifiers (every image needs a format, float/int/uint families), §4.9 Memory Access Qualifiers (coherent, volatile, restrict, readonly, writeonly; only r32f/r32i/r32ui may be read-write), §8.12 Image Functions (imageSize, imageLoad, imageStore), §8.14/§8.15 barrier() and memoryBarrierImage(), §7.1.3 Compute Shader Special Variables

api.glBindImageTexture: binds a level / layer / cube face of immutable textures to image units for 13 formats, layered and non-layered; every texel read or written by the shaders is compared with CPU models; IMAGE_BINDING_* of 4 bindings read back; unbind with texture 0; detach on glDeleteTextures; INVALID_OPERATION (mutable texture), INVALID_VALUE (unit, level, layer, texture name, 7 formats outside Table 8.26)
api.glGetIntegeri_v: IMAGE_BINDING_NAME / LEVEL / LAYER / ACCESS / FORMAT: initial values on every unit (Table 21.33) and the values after four different bindings; INVALID_VALUE for index == MAX_IMAGE_UNITS
api.glGetBooleani_v: IMAGE_BINDING_LAYERED: FALSE initially on every unit, TRUE after a layered array binding, FALSE after non-layered ones; INVALID_VALUE for index == MAX_IMAGE_UNITS
api.glGetTexParameteriv: IMAGE_FORMAT_COMPATIBILITY_TYPE == IMAGE_FORMAT_COMPATIBILITY_BY_SIZE for immutable 2D, 2D array and mutable textures allocated by the GL
api.glGetIntegerv: MAX_IMAGE_UNITS, MAX_COMPUTE_/MAX_COMBINED_/MAX_FRAGMENT_/MAX_VERTEX_IMAGE_UNIFORMS checked against the minimum values / used to gate the fragment-shader checks
api.glTexStorage2D: immutable 2D, cube and multi-level textures that image units require (13 formats, 5-level mip chains, 16x16 / 8x8 / 64x64)
api.glTexStorage3D: immutable 2D array and 3D textures bound layered and per layer
api.glTexImage2D: creates the mutable textures whose BindImageTexture raises INVALID_OPERATION and whose compatibility type is queried
api.glTexSubImage2D: uploads the source data of every format (Table 8.3 pairs), the source image, the level data and the cube faces; read back unchanged through samplers after the readonly image passes
api.glTexParameteri: NEAREST / NEAREST_MIPMAP_NEAREST filters (typed glTexParameter overloads) that make the integer, 32-bit float and mipmapped textures complete for the sampler read-backs
api.glDispatchCompute: format round trips, filters, layered and single-layer stores, imageSize, coherent/volatile reversal, reinterpretation copies: results compared with CPU models
api.glMemoryBarrier: SHADER_IMAGE_ACCESS between dependent image writes, TEXTURE_FETCH before sampler reads, FRAMEBUFFER before glReadPixels of image-written textures, BUFFER_UPDATE before MapBufferRange: the data of the next stage matches the CPU model
api.glCompileShader: five GLSL ES 3.10 image declaration errors (store to readonly, load from writeonly, rgba8 without readonly/writeonly, missing format qualifier, float format on uimage2D) fail to compile; the control shader compiles
api.glGenTextures: all textures of the passes; glDeleteTextures detaches a bound texture
api.glBindTexture: samplers on units 0..3 for the sampler read-backs and display, creation of textures, glTexParameteri targets
api.glDeleteTextures: a bound texture is detached from its image unit (IMAGE_BINDING_NAME 0); cleanup
api.glActiveTexture: units 0..3 for the four samplers of the display program
api.glGenBuffers: shader storage buffer that receives the texelFetch read-backs and the imageSize results
api.glBufferData: allocates the 128 KiB shader storage buffer
api.glBufferSubData: fills the storage buffer with a sentinel before every read-back; an unwritten word cannot match the model
api.glBindBufferBase: binds the storage buffer to binding point 0 of the read-back and imageSize shaders
api.glMapBufferRange: reads the words written by the compute shaders after BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT
api.glGenFramebuffers: framebuffer object for glReadPixels of image-written RGBA8 textures
api.glFramebufferTextureLayer: attaches each slice of the R32UI 3D texture in the crash-isolated child; the slice written through the non-layered image binding and the untouched slices are read back
api.glBindFramebuffer: FRAMEBUFFER target for the read-back and the default framebuffer for the display
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: attaches the blur / Sobel textures and the six cube faces to COLOR_ATTACHMENT0
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE for the RGBA8 attachments (otherwise the read-back is empty and the check fails)
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE: every texel of the blur and Sobel outputs against CPU references, the six cube faces, 8 probes per display cell of the capture; RGBA_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT: the four slices of an R32UI 3D texture after a non-layered slice store (crash-isolated child process)
api.glUseProgram: compute, display and fragment image programs
api.glGetUniformLocation: display, dump and fragment program uniforms
api.glUniform1i: sampler units, level, layer, mode of the dump and display programs
api.glUniform2i: texture size of the dump program, cell origin and cell size of the display programs (the grid is laid out from the surface size)
api.glUniform2f: gray ramp scale of the display program
api.glDrawArrays: fragment-shader imageStore pass (64x64 pixels) and the display cells (a triangle from gl_VertexID, empty VAO); the written texels and the capture pixels are compared with the model
api.glViewport: the full-surface viewport, the 16 cell viewports of the 4 x 4 grid (k * width / 4, k * height / 4) and the 64 x 64 image-store viewport

visual_review.notes: Window-size fix: 1000x200 llvmpipe capture viewed. The 4x4 grid fills the whole surface with 250x50 cells, each texture stretched over its cell (64x64 images minified vertically, 8x8 ramps as 8 bands), same content as below. Also viewed: 333x777 (83x194 cells, fills the window) and the 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture, unchanged from the earlier review. Earlier review: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed at 1x and 3x (llvmpipe and zink differ by at most 1/255 per channel). 4x4 sheet of 64x64 cells. Row 0: the gradient source with yellow disc, blue square and a pink/white checker patch; the same image blurred (soft disc edge, blurred square); the Sobel result (white outlines of disc, square and checker on black); the source color-inverted by the fragment shader (blue disc, yellow square). Row 1: four 8x8 ramps of the 2D array, gray / red / BLUE / yellow tints (layer 2 blue = the non-layered overwrite). Row 2: four 3D slices green / BLUE / blue / magenta (slice 1 = the single-slice overwrite). Row 3: flat orange level 0, a yellow-green inverted gradient for level 1, flat orange level 2, and a gray ramp black at the bottom left to white at the top right written by the fragment imageStore.
